description: Fig. 2 is a multi-panel composite; only six panels are present in the supplied image set — the caption's (a) and (b) (OIM and phase map of 28Mn0Ni) are absent. (c) and (e) are coloured EBSD orientation (OIM) maps with 50 µm scale bars of hot-rolled 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni respectively: (c) shows equiaxed polygonal grains in many orientations with a triangular IPF legend inset (top-right) labelled 111, 001 and 101; (e) shows a strongly banded structure of grains elongated along the vertical direction, including dark-red continuous bands. (d) and (f) are the corresponding phase maps (50 µm scale bars), red = γ and blue = B2 as printed in the legend of (f): (d) is almost entirely red with only sparse tiny blue specks, whereas (f) contains numerous blue, vertically aligned stringers. (g) is an IPF map of the B2 stringers of 15Mn5Ni alone, rendered as thin multicoloured vertical lines on a black background (50 µm scale bar). (h) is a greyscale ECCI micrograph at higher magnification (10 µm scale bar) in which the stringers are subdivided transversely, giving a bamboo-like, polycrystalline appearance. Together the panels demonstrate that B2 forms as narrow, polycrystalline, stringer-shaped bands that are far more abundant in 15Mn5Ni than in 28Mn5Ni.

subfigures.description: Coloured EBSD orientation (OIM) map of hot-rolled 28Mn5Ni; equiaxed polygonal grains in many orientation colours, 50 µm scale bar, with a triangular IPF colour-key inset in the top-right labelled 111 (top), 001 and 101.
Phase map of hot-rolled 28Mn5Ni; the field is almost entirely red (γ) with only sparse, very small blue (B2) features; 50 µm scale bar; no legend printed in this panel.

Coloured OIM map of hot-rolled 15Mn5Ni; grains strongly elongated along the vertical direction forming a banded structure, with darker red bands running parallel to it; 50 µm scale bar; no IPF colour key visible in this crop.
Phase map of hot-rolled 15Mn5Ni; red γ matrix crossed by numerous blue B2 stringers aligned vertically; legend box reads red = γ, blue = B2; 50 µm scale bar.
IPF/OIM map of the B2 stringers present in 15Mn5Ni; thin multicoloured vertical stringers on a black background, 50 µm scale bar.
Greyscale ECCI micrograph of hot-rolled 15Mn5Ni at higher magnification; vertical stringers subdivided transversely into segments giving a bamboo-like morphology; 10 µm scale bar.

observations.observation: Panel (c) is an orientation (OIM) map with a 50 µm scale bar showing equiaxed, polygonal grains in a wide range of orientation colours, with a triangular IPF legend inset labelled 111, 001 and 101 in the top-right.
Panel (e) has a 50 µm scale bar and shows grains strongly elongated along the vertical direction in a banded arrangement, unlike the equiaxed grains of (c).

Panel (d) is a phase map that is almost entirely red with only very few, small blue features, whereas panel (f) shows a red matrix traversed by many blue elongated vertical stringers; the legend printed in (f) assigns red to γ and blue to B2.
Panel (g) displays only the B2 phase on a black background as thin, multicoloured vertical stringers with a 50 µm scale bar.
Panel (h) is a greyscale ECCI micrograph with a 10 µm scale bar in which the vertical stringers appear subdivided by transverse boundaries into segments (bamboo-like morphology).
Panels (a) and (b), which the caption attributes to the 28Mn0Ni alloy, are not present in the supplied image set.

The caption states that (a,b), (c,d) and (e,f) are respectively the coloured OIM and phase maps of hot-rolled 28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni alloys, and that (g) is an IPF map of B2 stringers and (h) an ECCI micrograph of hot-rolled 15Mn5Ni at higher magnification.
The citing text states that grain sizes in the three hot-rolled alloys are similar, in the range of 5-7 µm.
The citing text states that the twin volume fraction V_f^T is highest in 28Mn5Ni (~40%), followed by 28Mn0Ni (~28%) and 15Mn5Ni (~7%).
The citing text states that the B2 volume fraction estimated from the phase maps is ~0.5%, 4% and 12% in 28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni respectively.
The citing text states that the B2 stringers formed during hot-rolling are polycrystalline with a bamboo-like morphology and a width in the range of 1-5 µm.
The citing text states that the crystallographic texture of the γ-matrix is similar and near-random in all three alloys.

The citing text reports that in the 15Mn5Ni alloy the B2 stringers (Fe-11.3Mn-12.2Al-7.4Ni, in wt.%) are richer in Al and Ni but deficient in Mn compared with the γ-matrix (Fe-15.2Mn-9.1Al-4.7Ni, in wt.%), as measured by SEM-EDS.

unreadable_items: panels (a) and (b) (reported in the caption for the 28Mn0Ni alloy) are not included in the supplied image set
panel (d): no phase legend is printed in the panel itself, so its red/blue key is inferred from the legend printed in (f)
panels (e) and (g): no IPF colour-key triangle is visible in the supplied crops, so individual grain orientation colours cannot be converted to Miller indices
